title: 第三章 集结
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

车子停在北郊一栋三层旧楼前面的时候，天色已经暗了一半。

这栋楼夹在一排汽修店和五金批发部之间，招牌上印着“众安安保服务有限公司”，有几个字的灯管不亮了，剩下的在暮色里闪着惨淡的白光。门口停着两辆印着同样字样的黑色面包车，车身上溅满了干掉的泥点子。

林越熄火下车。他没有急着进去，先站在车旁边扫了一遍周围环境。这是前世养成的肌肉记忆，改不掉——到达任何一个新地点，先找三个出口，两个火力点，一个隐蔽位。这栋楼的正面只有一扇玻璃门，左右各一个窗户，后面应该有消防通道。门口停着的面包车底盘够高，万一需要可以翻到车底。左边汽修店的楼顶视野不错，是狙击点，也是被狙击的风险点。

他在三十秒内完成了这套评估，然后推门走了进去。

一楼是个简陋的接待厅。一张人造革沙发，扶手上的皮已经裂了，露出黄色的海绵。茶几上放着几个一次性纸杯，其中一个里面还有半杯凉掉的茶水。墙上挂着“众安安保”的营业执照和几张队员合影，照片里的人都穿着统一的黑制服，站得笔直，但脸上的表情参差不齐——有的在努力板着脸，有的嘴角压不住笑。

赵铭从里面迎出来。他穿的不是制服，是一件洗得发白的军绿色T恤和一条深色工装裤，脚上蹬着作战靴，像是已经做好了随时出动的准备。二十四岁，比林越矮小半个头，身材精瘦，剃着板寸，眉眼之间还带着刚从部队出来没两年的那股子利索劲儿。他看着林越走进来，眼神里带着疑惑，但脚下没犹豫，直接迎到门口。

“林哥。”

“人呢？”林越没有寒暄。

“里面。”赵铭侧身带路，一边走一边说，“四个。都是我在部队带过的，退役之后跟着我过来的。大刘，机枪手退役，块头最大那个。小何，通信兵，会搞所有电子设备。阿青，卫生员，会包扎会打针，手特别稳。还有老郑，比我大五岁，侦察连出来的，是我老班长。”

林越在心里把这四个名字对上号。前世这四个名字他听过三个——大刘死在末世第一年的城北突围，被巨力丧尸捏碎了胸腔。老郑跟赵铭一起活到了第五年，是突击组成员，在最后那场尸潮里负责引开主力，没有回来。小何和阿青他没印象，说明前世他们没有跟赵铭走到最后，要么死于更早的混乱，要么根本没有跟赵铭汇合。

这一世，他们提前聚在一起了。

赵铭推开里间的门。这是一间不大的员工休息室，摆着一张折叠桌和几把椅子，墙上贴满了安保排班表和几张褪色的军事海报。四个人或坐或站，听到门响齐刷刷地转过头来。

林越走进去的一瞬间，四个人的反应各不相同。

大刘——坐在角落里那个膀大腰圆的汉子——上下打量了他一眼，眼神里是直白的审视。老郑靠在窗边，三十出头，脸上的线条比赵铭硬得多，目光冷沉，没有先开口，只是安静地观察。小何坐在桌边，面前摆着一台笔记本电脑，手指还搭在键盘上，抬头看了林越一眼，又低头继续敲了什么。阿青最年轻，看上去跟赵铭差不多大，坐在小何旁边，手里无意识地转着一支笔，表情是最没有防备的那个。

“这是林哥。”赵铭关上门，站在林越旁边，“就是我跟你们说的。”

“赵铭说你是他朋友。”老郑开口了，声音不高，但很稳，“你下午给他打了个电话，跟他说三天后出大事。然后他辞了职。带着我们几个一起。”

林越拉过一把椅子坐下来，面对着他们五个人。他没有兜圈子。

“我叫林越。二十六岁，建材销售。今天中午两点三十七分之前，我的一切跟你们没有任何交集。两点三十七分之后，我做的第一件事是给赵铭打电话。第二件事是去仓储超市踩点。第三件事是卖掉了我名下所有能变现的资产。”他把手机放在桌上，屏幕朝上，银行转账记录和卖车聊天记录都还留在上面，“我现在能动用的现金大概三十万。三天之内，我会花光。”

房间里安静了两秒。

“你说的大事，”老郑仍然靠在窗边，语气没有任何松动，“到底是什么。”

林越看着他。前世老郑就是这种人，话少，脑子快，不信任何没有经过验证的东西。他最后死的时候也没有废话，只是在引开尸潮之前回头跟赵铭说了一句“照看好剩下的人”。林越知道怎么跟这种人说话——用事实，不解释，不铺垫。

“三天后，这座城市会爆发一种病毒。体液传播，感染后十二小时内丧失全部认知能力，只保留原始攻击本能。你看到的每一个感染者都会变成食人怪物。我见过的最大尸潮超过百万。我在这座城市里活了五年。我死过一次。”

他说完，没有解释“死过一次”是什么意思，只是安静地等着。

“你说你死过一次。”大刘先开口了，浓眉皱在一起，“什么意思？”

“字面意思。”林越说，“末世第五年，我在城东的高架桥下和尸王同归于尽。然后我醒了。回到三天前。今天中午两点三十七分，在我公司的办公桌上。”

大刘看向赵铭，眼神里写满了“你确定你这朋友没毛病”。赵铭没有回他，只是看着林越。

“我今天下午的行程。”林越把手机屏幕转向他们，手指点着备忘录里的记录，“14点41分，联系苏沐晴，让她提前离开研究所。14点58分，到达万邦仓储超市，开始踩点，标记建材、五金、户外用品库存位置。15点50分，回家清点资产。16点15分，去市疾控中心接苏沐晴，交给她病毒特征，让她回去查全球数据库。16点40分，跟她分开。17点06分，到达这里。”

他把手机收回来，目光从五个人脸上扫过。

“我没有时间来跟你们解释逻辑闭环。你们可以相信我，也可以觉得我疯了。如果是后者，你们现在站起来走，明天早上起来继续上班，三天后各安天命。如果是前者——我需要你们。”

阿青手里的笔停了。小何的手指也停了，抬起头看着林越。老郑的目光终于从窗边移过来，落在林越脸上。大刘仍然皱着眉，但审视的味道少了一点，困惑的味道多了一点。

然后赵铭开口了。

“我信他。”

他三个字说得没有任何犹豫。林越转头看他。赵铭迎上他的视线，肩膀微微上提了一下，像是在下意识地挺直腰杆。

“林哥打电话的时候什么都没解释，就说了一句‘你信不信我’。我信的。”赵铭转向老郑，“班长，你也知道我不是那种脑子一热就上头的人。林哥今天说这些，换任何一个人说我都不信。但他说的方式——不是要说服我，是让我做选择。你要不要信他，也自己选。”

老郑看着赵铭，又转过来看林越。看了整整十秒钟。

Page (1/3)

When the car parked in front of an old three-story building in the northern suburbs, it was already half dark.

This building is sandwiched between a row of auto repair shops and a hardware wholesale department. The signboard reads "Zhongan Security Services Co., Ltd.". Some of the lights with these words are out, and the rest are shining with a pale white light in the dusk.Parked at the door were two black vans with the same words printed on them, their bodies splattered with dried mud.

Lin Yue turned off the engine and got out of the car.He didn't rush in. He stood next to the car and scanned the surroundings.This is the muscle memory developed in the previous life and cannot be changed - when arriving at any new location, first find three exits, two firepower points, and a hidden position.There is only one glass door on the front of the building, one window on the left and right, and there should be a fire exit behind it.The chassis of the van parked at the door is high enough that you can flip it underneath if necessary.The roof of the auto repair shop on the left has a good view. It is a sniper point and a risk point for being sniped.

He completed this assessment within thirty seconds, then opened the door and walked in.

The first floor is a simple reception hall.An artificial leather sofa, the leather on the armrests has cracked, revealing yellow sponge.There were several disposable paper cups on the coffee table, one of which had half a cup of cold tea in it.Hanging on the wall is the business license of "Zhongan Security" and several photos of team members. The people in the photos are all wearing uniform black uniforms and standing upright, but the expressions on their faces are varied - some are trying to keep a straight face, and some can't suppress a smile.

Zhao Ming came out to welcome him.He was not wearing a uniform, but a washed white military green T-shirt and a pair of dark overalls, with combat boots on his feet, as if he was ready to go out at any time.Twenty-four years old, half a head shorter than Lin Yue, lean and shaven, with a sharp look on his face that he had just been out of the army for two years.He watched Lin Yue walk in with doubts in his eyes, but he walked directly to the door without hesitation.

"Brother Lin."

"Where's the person?" Lin Yue said nothing.

"Inside." Zhao Ming led the way sideways and said as he walked, "Four. They were all brought by me in the army and followed me here after retiring. Liu, a retired machine gunner, the biggest one. Xiao He, a communications soldier, can handle all electronic equipment. Ah Qing, a hygienist, can bandage and inject, and has very steady hands. There is also Lao Zheng, who is five years older than me. He came out of the reconnaissance company and is my old squad leader."

Lin Yue matched these four names in his mind.He had heard three of these four names in his previous life - Da Liu died during the breakout in the north of the city in the first year of the apocalypse, and his chest was crushed by giant zombies.Lao Zheng lived with Zhao Ming until the fifth year. He was a member of the assault team. He was responsible for diverting the main force during the last zombie wave and did not come back.He had no memory of Xiao He and Ah Qing, which meant that they did not follow Zhao Ming to the end in their previous life, and either died in earlier chaos or did not join Zhao Ming at all.

In this life, they got together in advance.

Zhao Ming pushed open the inner door.This is a small employee lounge with a folding table and a few chairs. The walls are covered with security schedules and a few faded military posters.The four people were sitting or standing, and they all turned their heads when they heard the door ring.

The moment Lin Yue walked in, the four people had different reactions.

Da Liu—the big, round man sitting in the corner—looked him up and down with a direct look in his eyes.Lao Zheng was leaning against the window. He was in his early thirties. The lines on his face were much harder than those of Zhao Ming. His eyes were cold and he did not speak first, but just observed quietly.Xiao He was sitting at the table with a laptop in front of him, his fingers still resting on the keyboard. He looked up at Lin Yue, then lowered his head and continued typing.Ah Qing was the youngest and looked about the same age as Zhao Ming. He was sitting next to Xiao He, spinning a pen unconsciously in his hand, with the least defensive expression on his face.

"This is Brother Lin." Zhao Ming closed the door and stood next to Lin Yue, "This is what I told you."

"Zhao Ming said you were his friend." Lao Zheng spoke, his voice low but steady. "You called him in the afternoon and told him that something big will happen in three days. Then he resigned. He took us with him."

Lin Yue pulled up a chair and sat down, facing the five of them.He didn't beat around the bush.

"My name is Lin Yue. I am twenty-six years old. I sell building materials. Before 2:37 noon today, I had nothing to do with you. After 2:37, the first thing I did was to call Zhao Ming. The second thing was to go to the warehouse supermarket. Chapter 1The third thing is to sell all the assets in my name that can be liquidated." He put the phone on the table with the screen facing up, and the bank transfer records and car sales chat records were still on it. "I will spend about 300,000 yuan in cash now."

The room was quiet for two seconds.

"The big thing you mentioned," Lao Zheng was still leaning against the window, his tone not loosening at all, "what exactly is it."

Lin Yue looked at him.In his previous life, Lao Zheng was this kind of person. He talked little and had a quick mind. He didn't believe anything that wasn't verified.When he died in the end, he didn't talk nonsense. He just turned around and said to Zhao Ming, "Take care of the remaining people" before diverting the tide of corpses.Lin Yue knew how to talk to this kind of person - with facts, without explanation or foreshadowing.

"Three days later, a virus will break out in this city. It spreads through bodily fluids and loses all cognitive abilities within twelve hours of infection, retaining only primitive attack instincts. Every infected person you see will turn into a man-eating monster. The largest corpse wave I have ever seen exceeds a million. I have lived in this city for five years. I have died once."

After he finished speaking, he didn't explain what "died once" meant, and just waited quietly.

"You said you died once." Da Liu spoke first, his thick eyebrows knitting together, "What do you mean?"

"Literally." Lin Yue said, "In the fifth year of the apocalypse, I died together with the Corpse King under the viaduct in the east of the city. Then I woke up. Back to three days ago. Today at 2:37 noon, I was on my desk in my company."

Da Liu looked at Zhao Ming, his eyes filled with "Are you sure there is nothing wrong with your friend?"Zhao Ming didn't reply to him, just looked at Lin Yue.

"My schedule for this afternoon." Lin Yue turned the phone screen to them and pointed at the records in the memo. "At 14:41, I contacted Su Muqing and asked her to leave the research institute early. At 14:58, I arrived at Wanbang Warehouse Supermarket and started to check out the points, marking building materials, fiveAt 15:50, we went home to check our assets.At 16:15, we went to pick up Su Muqing and asked her to go back and check the global database.At 16:40, we arrived here."

He took his phone back and glanced across the faces of the five people.

"I don't have time to explain the closed loop of logic to you. You can believe me, or you can think I'm crazy. If it's the latter, you get up and go now, get up and go to work tomorrow morning, and take care of your destiny in three days. If it's the former - I need you."

The pen in Ah Qing's hand stopped.Xiao He also stopped his fingers and raised his head to look at Lin Yue.Lao Zheng's eyes finally moved from the window and landed on Lin Yue's face.Da Liu still frowned, but with less scrutiny and more confusion.

Then Zhao Ming spoke.

"I believe him."

He said these three words without any hesitation.Lin Yue turned to look at him.Zhao Ming met his gaze and raised his shoulders slightly, as if he was subconsciously straightening his waist.

"Brother Lin didn't explain anything when he called. He just said, 'Believe me or not.' I believe it." Zhao Ming turned to Lao Zheng, "Squad leader, you also know that I am not the kind of person who gets mad when his head gets hot. I wouldn't believe what Brother Lin said today if anyone else said it. But the way he said it - he didn't want to convince me, but let me make a choice. Whether you believe him or not, you can make your own choice."

Lao Zheng looked at Zhao Ming, then turned to look at Lin Yue.I watched it for a full ten seconds.
